# Finite quantum gravity v6: tables placed and sized correctly (v2.1.1)

Layout fix of "Finite quantum gravity from a scale-invariant gas of branes" (`uv-finite/`, 47 pages). The text, results, code and figures are unchanged from 2.1.0.
- Table XII (status of the claims) is full width and sits next to the Discussion; before, it overran its column at the end of the paper.
- The table of checks is split into Tables XIV and XV, both placed before the references; Table XIII (notation) sits with Appendix A.
- The paper's code is archived in 2.1.0, 10.5281/zenodo.23225731, which the paper cites.

Assets: paper PDF, LaTeX source (tex.zip), arXiv package (tar.gz), all 16 figures (figures.zip).
